behaviours.name: Unholy Endurance (Carve damage)
behaviours.quote: Increases the damage and threat generated from Carve by $s1%.
behaviours.observe_source: Hit size: both arms carry attack power +20000 (fixture, a named precondition, the same in control and treatment). Carve's strike is 20% weapon damage (AscensionFelswornContracts.cpp:166-175) and the weapon roll includes the normalized attack power term, so a hit is about 890 points in the control arm and 1023 with the passive (measured hit sizes of the counted pair): each of the two integer truncations of SpellEffects.cpp:4743 and Unit.cpp:11670 loses under 1 point, so under 0.12% of a hit each and under 0.25% together, inside the band of 2 points; at ~30-point hits the same truncations cost about 3 points of the 15 (the first proves read +11.1% and +12.3% from that truncation, not from the server). $s1 = 15 (300466 Effect[0] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, EffectBasePoints 14 + EffectDieSides 1, MiscValue 0 = SPELLMOD_DAMAGE; Spell.dbc read with apps/coa-dbc/inspect_dbc.py), class mask 0x80 of family 20 widened by AscensionFelswornContracts.cpp:29-33 to 0x80/0/0x200000. Carve's strike 803715 (SpellFamilyFlags[0] 0x80, weapon percent damage) is cast at the dummy trials times without the passive (control) and with it learned by a real learn (treatment), non-critical hits only; mean damage per hit must rise by 15 percent (band 13..17, G-19). The control arm is the same cast without 300466. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 300466: 0 events in 186 logs (passive, never logged); coa-history spell 803715 (Carve hit): SPELL_DAMAGE 1086 events in 5 logs, 188 crits, min 37 max 1630 mean 307 (gear and channel length differ, no figure decides); bindmysoul talents snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22): Unholy Endurance 300466, Tyrant specialization, 'Increases the damage and threat generated from Carve by 15%.', same figure as the tooltip; nothing else found.

behaviours.observe_source: Expected 15000 ms: Spell.dbc 801902 DurationIndex 8, SpellDuration.dbc row 8 Duration 15000 (the $801902d of the tooltip). 801902 is cast on the caster by the Legionfall handler (AscensionFelswornEvents.cpp:201-203) after a landed melee ability hit rolled Chance() on the raw ProcChance 15 (AscensionFelsworn.cpp:231-239), which no spell modifier forces, so the aura is earned for real: the cast_until_aura step (owner-approved) casts Annihilan Strike every 1700 ms until 801902 is on the caster, at most 47 casts (one roll per cast at 15% leaves 0.85^47 = 0.05% of a run without a grant, a landed strike pair only lowers it; a run at the cap is unmeasured, never a fail or a pass). The control arm casts the same loop without the talent (801899 learned after it) and must read no 801902. Before the measured arm 801902 is cancelled on the caster and read absent with its application count, the loop's casts are the only casts and stop at the first grant, so no proc of an earlier loop turn is on; Energy and the cooldown are set before each cast. After the stop, every 50 ms the game time, the 801902 application count and its presence are read on the caster; the first read is at most 100 ms after the grant (the step checks the aura on every world update) and the remaining duration is read at the stop. The aura must be gone 15000 ms (G-19 band 14250 to 15750) after the grant, with one counted application and no recast. Annihilan Strike 801903 (40 Energy, 10000 ms category cooldown, both weapons) lands two strikes (801913, 801914); its cooldown and Energy are reset before every loop cast and the Slayer pair is the class's weapon set. An encounter timeline opened before the measured feed (after a game time read) stamps every apply of 801902 on the caster in the game time base, so the aura's age at the first read after the loop is read, not derived from the expected duration (mentor D-21, review I-1): above 100 ms, without a stamp, or with a stamped apply count other than one (a refresh or a second apply is not the stamped first apply, so the last application would be unbounded) the arm is unmeasured. The timeline is process global, so the scenario runs exclusive in a batch. Reference search: coa-history spell 801899 and 801902: 0 events in 186 logs; ~/CoaServer/reference snapshots (ascension-data advancement.tsv, bindmysoul talents) list the talent without a rate or duration; nothing found for the value.

The Malice handler (AscensionFelswornEvents.cpp:97-98, :227-229) casts Felstrike 802678 on the target and Fragment of Malice 800239 on the caster after a direct critical hit rolled Chance() on the raw ProcChance 60 (AscensionFelsworn.cpp:231-239), which no spell modifier forces. The spell crit and hit rating fixtures (no miss, no resist roll) makes every cast hit and critical, and the cast_until_aura step casts Fel Fireball every 2000 ms (a cast time of 1500 ms plus the projectile) until 800239 is on the caster, at most 9 casts (one 60% roll per cast leaves 0.4^9 = 0.03% of a run without a grant; a run at the cap is unmeasured, never a fail or a pass); both arms are fed alike and the control arm has no talent (800214 learned after it). Sargeron Smite 802060 cannot feed the loop: it costs 2 Felfury (AscensionCustomResourceData.h:533), which the step does not refill (18 of 18 casts refused with reason 85, NO_POWER, pair 20261123-152023). An encounter timeline opened before the measured feed (after a game time read) stamps every apply of 802678 on the dummy in the game time base, so the aura's age at the first read after the loop is read, not derived from the expected duration (mentor D-21, review I-1): above 100 ms, without a stamp, or with a stamped apply count other than one (a refresh or a second apply is not the stamped first apply, so the last application would be unbounded) the arm is unmeasured. The timeline is process global, so the scenario runs exclusive in a batch. Reference search: coa-history spell 800214: 0 events in 186 logs; 802678 Felstrike has aura events (applied 1265, dose 1309, refresh 5692, removed 1267) but the summary carries no stack count or duration; raw logs (coa-history data/logs, last application or refresh to removed per spell, source and target, re-read 2026-11-23): 802678 n=1267, main cluster 5800-6099 ms (403 in 5900-5999; shorter intervals are removals before the expiry), 800239 n=678, median 5040 ms, p10 4769, p90 5266; 800239 Fragment of Malice: applied 678, refresh 4066, removed 678, energize 5 each (4744); the live intervals corroborate 6000 and 5000 ms; nothing found for a cap.

behaviours.name: Fel Haze (all enemy armor ignored under Blood of Mannoroth)
behaviours.quote: While active, Blood of Mannoroth now also causes you to ignore all enemy Armor.
behaviours.expected_source: 803903 Effect[0] aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER MiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1) EffectBasePoints 99 (+100) on Blood of Mannoroth 802075 (class mask 0x200000 of family 20, SpellFamilyFlags[0] 2097152), whose Effect[0] is aura 280 SPELL_AURA_MOD_ARMOR_PENETRATION_PCT with EffectBasePoints -1 (0%) in the DBC, moved by the Felsworn contract to aura 338 SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_IGNORE_ARMOR_PCT (Felsworn ADR 0008, owner ruling O-13), so the stock armor penetration cap (at most (armor + K) / 3, ratio 1.5) does not apply: with the passive 100% of the armor is ignored. Carve's strike 803715 (physical weapon damage) is cast at the dummy in two arms, each hit non-critical. Increase Damage 37643 (Effect[0] aura 79 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE, MiscValue 127, a stock single-effect self aura) is set on the caster in both arms with its effect 0 amount changed to 19900 (x200, a fixture size, not a claimed value) so each hit is large (about 3000 before armor) and the engine's ceil on the armored control hit adds less than 0.1%; without it a 14-16 hit rounds to 7-8 and the ratio reads about 1.95 (Felsworn ADR 0008). Lesser Armor 673 (Effect[0] aura 22 SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE) is set on the dummy with its effect 0 amount changed to 5000 in both arms (a fixture size, not a claimed value) so the dummy armor reads 5528 (528 pinned reference armor plus 5000), as the Sun Cleric Vindicator 707773 ignores_armor entry. Classic combat armor mitigation at caster level 60: damage kept = K / (armor + K), K = 85 x 60 + 400 = 5500 (Unit.cpp ClassicPlusCombat::ArmorConstant). Control arm: Blood of Mannoroth 802075 set on the caster (a precondition fixture by harness set_aura, the condition of the clause, not its subject) with 803903 not learned: the full armor applies; treatment arm: 803903 learned, the same Blood: nothing is mitigated, so the mean hit ratio is (5528 + 5500) / 5500 = 2.0051 (+100.5%); band the larger of 5% of +100% and 2 points (95% to 105%), and a server ignoring 90% of the armor (ratio 1.822) or 50% (1.50) lies outside it. The expected value comes from the DBC amount and the armor formula, never from a run. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 803903: 0 events in 186 logs (passive, never logged); spell 802075 Blood of Mannoroth: SPELL_CAST_SUCCESS 33 events in 10 logs (a positive control that the active is logged; no armor figure); bindmysoul talents snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22): Fel Haze 803903 'While active, Blood of Mannoroth now also causes you to ignore all enemy Armor.', same wording as the tooltip; nothing else found.

Feed: Azzinoth's Assault 803475 (the level 60 rank, GCD 1000 ms, needs 803468 and 2 Felfury per cast) at the dummy every 1100 ms; its two strikes 520262 and 572585 (melee, not Derived, AscensionFelsworn.cpp:61-69) are direct hits, made critical by the melee crit rating fixture; the class file's hit and expertise ratings remove misses, dodges and parries. Control: the same five casts before 800214 is learned read 0 stacks. Treatment: 6 trials of five casts each (stack_feed), each valid with at least 4 counted applications whose poll spans stay under 6000 ms; a valid trial passes at exactly 3 stacks, never 4. Design arithmetic only (not the residual): 10 strikes at 60% leave fewer than 4 applications in 5.5% of trials if every strike crits and lands; measured: pair prove1 (build 100257c26805, 2026-11-23) v = 0/4 in both runs; pair fw-tgs2 prove (server c3bd6628a143, 2026-11-23) v = 0/4 and 1/4, so the larger v = 1/4 sizes N = 6: (1/4)^6 = 0.024%, at most 0.05%; 1.40 and 1.00, then 1.15 and 1.33 applications per feed cast in the valid trials (per cast, not per hit: the scenario reads no hit count). Reference search 2026-11-23 (fw-b1b): coa-history 802678 16516 periodic damage events, nothing for the stack count.

AscensionFelswornAbilities.cpp:192-193 multiplies a critical 803715 hit by 1 + $807427s1 / 100 x min(10, steps) when 805236 is known and Inner Demon 804216 was on the caster when the strike was cast (owner rulings O-21 and O-23, Felsworn ADR 0011: +5% of the whole critical hit per step, +50% at 10 steps; the tooltip's 60% is unreachable). Both arms channel Carve to its end at the one dummy with Felfury 800058 set to 4 before every trial, melee crits forced and attack power +20000 (fixtures, the same in both arms), so the weapon dice (17.25-28.75 of about 3450 normalized points) move a hit under 0.2%; the treatment learns 805236 for real. The one-step arm (1.05) needs a channel cancelled after one step, which hit_ratio cannot schedule; the scenario felsworn-grommash-folly-carve-crit.json covers it. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 807427: 3 logs, 3-4 stacks per channel that expire 0.5 s after the first step, crit/non-crit median ratio 1.94-1.98 against 1.94 without the talent (no measurable bonus on live); the bindmysoul and coabuildhub snapshots repeat the tooltip with 5%; nothing found that states another value.

behaviours.observe_source: 563268 Felrend EffectRadiusIndex 193 = 6 yd ($a1), TargetA 22 SRC_CASTER, TargetB 15 SRC_AREA_ENEMY. A player caster's area search adds the area leeway 2.66 yd (Spell.cpp:1388-1394, Object.cpp:1787-1808) and a non-player target's combat reach, 1.275 yd for the dummy entry 36 (Spell.cpp:9437-9442; creature_model_info 367): edge 6 + 2.66 + 1.275 = 9.935 yd from the caster (guide G-29). area1 stands at 9.435 yd (0.5 yd inside) and area2 at 10.435 yd (0.5 yd beyond): the main hand 563268 must strike area1 and not area2, so a radius from 1.6 to 6.5 yd no longer passes; it needs 5.5 <= r < 6.5 around the stated 6. The option reads the positions, the reaches and the caster's run speed rate, recomputes the edge from them, voids a layout that does not bracket it, and alerts when area1 is unstruck or area2 struck; area1 struck is the positive read that the cast landed. The dummy (5 yd) is struck once (expected 1); control arm: before the cast the same read is 0. The off hand 803476 is judged by the off_* entries (mentor D-57), not here.
